									<p>The MSc Sustainable Financial Management with Data Analytics is taught 100% in English at our <b data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="108">Barcelona</b> campus.</p><p>It offers two tracks depending on your background: a <b data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="179">1-year MSc</b> (for students with a 4-year Bachelor’s) or a <b data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="235">2-year MSc</b> (for students with a 3-year Bachelor’s). Both tracks are full-time., delivered at TBS Education’s Barcelona campus.</p><p>Barcelona offers students an international, business-friendly environment with strong connections to the financial sector across Spain and Europe, alongside a high quality of life. Throughout the program, students benefit from small class sizes, hands-on case studies, and direct access to TBS Education’s network of partner companies in finance, auditing, and consulting, all while studying in one of southern Europe’s most dynamic financial and innovation hubs.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-6343" class="e-n-accordion-item" >

					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> WHAT DEGREE WILL I OBTAIN UPON COMPLETION? </div></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div data-particle_enable="false" data-particle-mobile-disabled="false" role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-6343" class="elementor-element elementor-element-ada0824 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="ada0824" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-353a3ee elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="353a3ee" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Graduates receive the <b data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="67">MSc Sustainable Financial Management with Data Analytics</b>, a French state-recognized Master’s degree (<i data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="168">Diplôme d’Études Supérieures en Management Stratégique International</i>), which is fully accredited by the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research</p><p>Also, TBS Education, is a triple-accredited business school recognized internationally. This triple accreditation places the degree among a select group of business school qualifications worldwide, giving graduates strong credibility with employers in finance, auditing, and consulting.</p><p>The diploma certifies both technical competency in financial management and data analytics, as well as specialized knowledge in ESG and sustainable finance practices increasingly required across the industry.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>

							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div data-particle_enable="false" data-particle-mobile-disabled="false" role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-6344" class="elementor-element elementor-element-194175e e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="194175e" data-element_type="container">

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4887ef1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4887ef1" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Yes. A key feature of this MSc is the dedicated preparation module for the <b data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="131">CFA Institute’s Certificate in ESG Investing</b>. This globally recognized certification demonstrates your expertise in sustainable investment to employers worldwide.</p><p>Alongside the official MSc diploma, the program can incorporate industry-recognized certifications that strengthen students’ CVs and demonstrate practical mastery of key tools and frameworks used in sustainable finance and data analytics. These certifications complement the academic curriculum by validating specific technical skills sought by recruiters, giving graduates an additional credential that sets them apart when applying for roles in ESG analysis, sustainable investment, or financial data analytics.</p>								</div>
